newsitem.title: UK: Allied Domecq shares face squeeze - papers.
newsitem.headline: Allied Domecq shares face squeeze - papers.

text.p: Shares in drinks and retailing group Allied Domecq are expected to come under pressure this week because chairman Sir Christopher Hogg is likely to dismiss plans to demerge the business, according to newspaper reports.
Some analysts and institutional investors hope Hogg will announce plans to restructure or demerge the business when the company reports its full year results on Tuesday.

"No explicit rejection of demerger proposals is expected, but Sir Christopher will make clear that Allied plans to continue to develop its spirits and retail activities in tandem," said the Times newspaper.
The Financial Times said Hogg is focusing for now on improving the company's performance. "He is believed to have rejected the quick fix of a demerger," said the FT.
Allied shares have gained about 10 percent in the last month to close at 484-1/2p on Friday, but still a long way off their high for the year of 557p.
